summary: Agent stopped: no documented mapping from a subscription's entitlement_flags to the billing ledger's invoice lines.

diagnosis.explanation: The package describes entitlement_flags on the subscription record and, separately, how the billing ledger prices invoice lines from a ratecard. Nothing states how an entitlement flag becomes a billed line: whether the ledger reads entitlement_flags directly, whether ratecard_code is the same identifier as the entitlement code, or whether a new billable entitlement needs an explicit ratecard entry.
diagnosis.technical_details: Searched larkspur-index.md, rules/plan-rules.md, data/account-model.md, data/billing-ledger.md. account-model.md defers invoicing to 'the billing ledger's concern'; billing-ledger.md prices lines from active billable entitlements but never defines how activeness is read from entitlement_flags.
recommendations: Add a section describing how entitlement_flags propagate to invoice lines, and whether the correspondence is by shared code or an explicit mapping.
State whether a new billable entitlement requires a ratecard entry or is billed automatically once its flag is set.
